items.title: THANKS TO TRUMP, THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ REMAINS CLOSED FOR ALL PRACTICAL PURPOSES.
items.content:
THANKS TO TRUMP, THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ REMAINS CLOSED FOR ALL PRACTICAL PURPOSES. 
 x.com/kpler/status/209584817… Kpler (@Kpler)Hormuz crossings fall by half

Strait of Hormuz traffic declined sharply on 31 August, with five confirmed crossings, down 50% from 10 a day earlier. Four vessels entered the Middle East Gulf and one exited, using a mix of Iranian, Omani and negotiated routes. Two crossings involved shadow vessels and one involved a sanctioned vessel.

The figure remains preliminary, as additional “dark” crossings may be retrospectively identified and added as new confirmation data becomes available. Bab el-Mandeb activity was comparatively stable, with 35 confirmed crossings, up 2.9% day on day. Of these, 19 entered the Red Sea and 16 exited. No dark transits were recorded, while the International Maritime Organization verified no additional attacks.
